grammar.summary: 本课对比一般现在时与现在进行时：习惯 vs 此刻。

points.title: 一般现在时 vs 现在进行时
points.explanation: It is eight o'clock. The children go to school by car every day.（习惯）But today, they are going to school on foot.（今天例外，用进行时）。always/usually 等频率词配一般现在时。

examples.en: But this morning, Mrs. Sawyer is going to the shops.
examples.cn: 但今天早上，Sawyer 太太正去商店。

examples.en: He usually reads his newspaper at night.
